text:
Predicates:
FavoriteSeason(x, y) ::: x's favorite season is y.
WantsLongVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter ::: constants representing the seasons.
Emma, Mia, James ::: constants representing the individuals.
Premises:
∀x (WantsLongVacation(x) → FavoriteSeason(x, summer)) ::: All students who want a long vacation love summer the most.
FavoriteSeason(Emma, summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
FavoriteSeason(Mia, s) ∧ s ≠ summer ::: Mia's favorite season is not summer.
WantsLongVacation(James) ::: James wants to have a long vacation.
Conclusion:
FavoriteSeason(James, summer) ::: James's favorite season is summer.
